chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim that Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Marry, for I will outnumber the nations through you tomorrow on the Day of Resurrection, such that even the miscarried child will come lingering at the gate of Paradise. Then it will be said to him, ‘Enter Paradise,’ and he will say, ‘No, not until my parents enter Paradise before me.’”

key_terms.الْقِيَامَةِ: The Day of Resurrection and Judgment
key_terms.تَزَوَّجُوا: Marry; an exhortation to enter marriage
key_terms.مُكَاثِرٌ: Taking pride in great numbers; increasing in number before others

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about marriage and the miscarried child on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages marriage and presents it as a means of increasing the community of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It also highlights a scene of the afterlife in which even a miscarried child is granted a special station and seeks the entry of his parents into Paradise before himself.
